pages.markdown:
# Generic AI gives generic work. Build one that's yours.

Rivus is an AI you shape: it holds your information, your standards, your way of working, and gets sharper the more you use it.

[Join the waitlist](https://rivus.work/a/en/#waitlist) Early access, rolling out to a second group.

![Rivus work session: a finished meeting-prep document, with the situation, the recommendation and what each person will press you on.](https://rivus.work/assets/images/hero-poster-desktop-1080w.png)

## You're doing half the work the AI was supposed to do.

- You open a blank chat and start over.
- Paste in all the background (again).
- Spell out what you're deciding, what you tried, what matters to you (again).
- Fight your way past the obvious.
- Basically rewrite half of it by hand through a lot of iterations, because it could have been written for anyone.

And by the end, the work that leaves your desk comes out a little more generic than it should.

HOW IT'S DIFFERENT

## The fix isn't a better prompt.  It's an AI that's yours.

What you're working on, the calls you've made, what matters to you: all inside.

![Rivus surface: the work updates in place, turn by turn](https://rivus.work/assets/images/surface-poster-en-940w.png)

01

A chat only grows downward. This stays one place.

02

The work updates as you go, instead of scrolling away.

03

Always shows where you are

What's decided, what's open, what's next.

You're not chatting with an assistant. You're watching your work take shape, turn by turn.

## Same question.  One agrees with you. One thinks with you.

"I'm leaning toward moving **most of Q3 into content**. Think it through with me **before I commit**. **Where does this fall apart?**"

GENERIC AI

"That's a reasonable direction. Content builds durable, compounding value, and trimming paid spend can improve efficiency. A few things to keep in mind: timeline, measurement, and keeping some budget flexible. On the whole, a solid plan. You could move forward with confidence."

RIVUS, THINKING IT THROUGH WITH YOU

Before you commit, let's run it against your own rules.

- You don't move budget unless it pays back inside two quarters, and content won't by then. So "most of it" is too far.
- Last year you cut events on the same logic and it aged well. Same call here, so 60%, not all.
- Keep some of your paid ads running so the pipeline doesn't dip while content ramps.
- If you want to go bigger, the honest version is a one-channel test for a quarter, not a full shift.

Want to pressure-test the rule, or run a couple of other scenarios first?

FAQ

## The questions we get, answered straight.

### How is this different from ChatGPT/Claude, or a custom GPT I set up myself?

A prompt or a custom GPT is a set of instructions, fixed the day you wrote it. Rivus is a system built around your work: it holds your information, works a problem from more than one angle, and gets sharper the more you use it. Your prompts don't learn your standards, don't remember the call you made last quarter, and don't carry a decision into the next one. Rivus does, and that's the part you can't copy-paste.

### Isn't building my own AI a lot of setup?

You don't sit down and configure it. It comes with a way of working built in, and it learns as you use it, from the actual work you're doing. There's no blank setup screen to fill in before you get value. The "building" happens while you work, not before.

### Is my information private? Who can see it?

What you put into Rivus is yours. It lives in plain files on your own machine, not in a shared cloud pool, so it isn't mixed in with anyone else's. It stays yours, and it travels with you.

### Another subscription on top of what I already pay for AI?

Rivus isn't one more chat to add to the pile. It's meant to replace the daily fight, pasting information, re-explaining, editing generic output by hand. If you're already paying for AI and still doing that, this is where that spend actually pays off.

### If I leave, do I lose what I built?

No. Your work and your information are portable, they're yours to take. We'd rather earn you staying because it keeps getting better, not because you're locked in.

### Do I need to know anything technical?

No. There's nothing to wire up or configure. If you can use a chat, you can use Rivus.

## Start building your AI.

Run the same AI as everyone and your edge is the same as everyone's: none.

Build your own, and five weeks in, it's an advantage no one can copy.

We're not building the AI that does the work. We're building the one that keeps it yours.

pages.title: Manifesto · Rivus
pages.markdown:
WHAT WE BELIEVERIVUS / MANIFESTO

# Most AI is built to do your work. We build AI to make your work _better_.

Most AI today is racing to do more of the work for you: draft it, decide it, ship it while you watch. That's one bet. We're making a different one.

What you're paid for is your thinking, and a tool should sharpen it, not quietly take it over. Rivus isn't built to replace you. It's built to make you sharper and keep your name on the work.

## FIVE PRINCIPLES

01

### AI should make you sharper, not just faster.

It's easy to let a tool do more and more of the thinking. We'd rather build one you think with, so you come out of a session with more, not less.

02

### The work stays yours.

Everything that leaves your desk carries your judgment, your call, your voice. Not a generic draft a machine scraped together. If a reader can tell it was AI, we failed at our job.

03

### You're the center, not a step in the loop.

A lot of tools put the machine in charge of the process and leave you to approve the output. We build it the other way around: you run the work, and the AI works inside your loop, on your terms.

04

### It's yours, not everyone's.

A blank AI shared by millions gives everyone the same answer. Yours holds your information and your standards, and gets sharper the more you use it. You own it, you don't rent it, and it goes where you go.

05

### A good tool has a point of view.

A neutral tool that does whatever you ask, however you ask, gives you mush. We have opinions about what good work looks like, and we build them in. You can push back, but you'll never start from nothing, and it'll never just tell you your idea is great.

WHO'S BEHIND RIVUS

We're Franco and Herman. We met at university and spent eight years running a digital product studio.

We're over-thinkers by nature, and we built Rivus for the work we do every day: the memo, the call, the piece that has to be right and has to sound like us. We tried handing that work to AI and hated what came back, generic, forgetful, someone else's voice.

So we built the tool we wanted: one that holds our information, works the way we work, and leaves the thinking to us.

We're building Rivus for people who make their living on their own judgment and produce the work with their own hands. If that's you, it's built for you, by two people who need it as much as you do.

Franco Patrone · Herman Persitz

## Share the bet? Join us.

Early access is rolling out to a second group.

[Join the waitlist](https://rivus.work/a/en/#waitlist)
